# Waymark 0.4.1

- The minimap header shows the region containing the detected player position instead of the selected world map's name.
- A recent last-known region remains visible during brief reading gaps. After 30 seconds without usable position evidence, the title becomes **Unavailable**. Unmapped positions and manual or replay starts are not presented as the live region.
- Long region names use an ellipsis, with the full name on hover. Zoom, padlock and close controls stay visible.
- All three minimap zoom tiers are closer: 360, 720 and 1,280 map units across, previously 640, 1,280 and 2,240. The closest tier is the default; your saved tier choice is preserved.

- A foldable Recent souls strip under the minimap follows the latest three pet pickups. Portrait rings show tier progress, use your custom rank colors and briefly celebrate a newly confirmed Lv.3 before it leaves the strip. Estimated maximum ranks remain visible until confirmed. Folding is remembered, and the Windows frame grows to preserve the terrain view.

Click-through locking, Ctrl+Shift+G to unlock, always-on-top behavior, saved positioning, filters, colors and progress are preserved. Dungeon-entry recognition is not added by this change; unreadable dungeon interiors fall back to Unavailable when the last outdoor fix expires.
